newsitem.title: USA: Coinmach to acquire Kwik Wash for $140 mln.
newsitem.headline: Coinmach to acquire Kwik Wash for $140 mln.

text.p: Coinmach Laundry Corp said on Monday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Kwik Wash Laundries LP for $125 million cash and a $15 million promissory note.

Kwik Wash, which provides coin-operated laundry equipment services to multi-family dwellings in Texas, Louisana, Arkansas and Oklahoma, had revenues of $65 million and earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of about $23 million for the 12 months ended September 30.
Separately, Coinmach said it had received a commitment for up to $180 million in senior financing.
This facility will replace its existing $35 million facility and will provide financing to support its acquisition strategy, it said.
